BiblicalUsage: Machazioth was a son of Heman, one of the singers set apart for the service of song in 1 Chronicles 25:4, and 1 Chronicles 25:30 says the three and twentieth course fell to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, twelve in all. His course was the three and twentieth, and he served with his sons and his brethren, twelve in all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God orders worship down to the rota: every singer had his course, and none of them was left out of the count.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
